title: Learning Structure-from-Motion with Graph Attention Networks
caption: Figure 1. Illustration of the different types of features in the net- work architecture, for m = 3 cameras and n = 6 scene points. The projection features P are represented by a sparse vector- valued matrix, with its sparsity pattern determined by the point track measurements, while view features V and scene point fea- tures S are represented by dense vector-values column and row vectors. A single vector g holds global features.
